board: Adafruit LTR-329 Light Sensor - STEMMA QT / Qwiic (#5591)
reason: Modelled from the Lite-On LTR-329ALS-01 datasheet (DS86-2014-0006): address 0x29, PART_ID 0xA0, ALS_CONTR/ALS_MEAS_RATE setup, status bit 2, CH1-then-CH0 little-endian 16-bit data at 0x88-0x8B, and the Appendix A lux formula (cross-checked with Pycom's driver); header order VIN,3Vo,GND,SCL,SDA from Adafruit's Eagle board file. Part check printed PASS on ESP32 and Pico (CH0=2000 CH1=600 Lux=4212.1, DRC clean).
